title: Add sanctioned map_task.py retire verb and close the missing-lifecycle-verb pattern
description: THIRD instance of one recurring pattern: a legitimate lifecycle transition has no sanctioned map_task.py verb, so agents fall back to direct SQL against canonical task state. (1) REPAIR-0009: output-path removal, no verb, raw SQL. (2) REPAIR-0010 then REPAIR-0012: max_attempts extension, no verb, raw SQL twice in two days -- now being fixed by TASK-293. (3) 2026-07-28: mapfinish-guru retired TASK-053 and reported 'No retire verb in map_task.py, so did it as a direct status mutation + PROGRESS event + exporter resync, same pattern TASK-241-248 used under TASK-254.' Sixteen tasks are now RETIRED and not one of them went through a gated, evented, mirror-synchronized verb. The harness permission classifier now also blocks raw SQL against canonical task state, so this fallback is becoming unavailable as well as undesirable. map_task.py currently exposes create/approve/reject/rework/submit/release/recover/reassign/add-output-path/show/log -- retire is a real terminal transition and is missing. Fix the specific gap AND state whether any other lifecycle transition is still verb-less, so this is the last instance of the pattern rather than the third.
acceptance_criteria: map_task.py gains a retire verb taking a task_id, --actor, and a required --reason, which moves a task to RETIRED inside a SQLite transaction, appends a durable canonical event naming actor and reason, and re-exports task/graph mirrors, matching the shape of the existing lifecycle verbs.
The verb refuses to retire a task that is already terminal (RELEASED/RETIRED/DONE) and refuses an empty reason, so retirement cannot silently overwrite a completed task's history.
Focused tests cover successful retirement, refusal on each terminal status, refusal on empty reason, and mirror re-export; wired into run_tests.sh and the suite passes.

The task record enumerates every tasks-table lifecycle transition an agent can legitimately need, states which now have a sanctioned verb after this task and TASK-293 land, and explicitly names any that still do not -- so the remaining gap is documented rather than rediscovered a fourth time.
